metaTitle: Custom Blue Lapel Pins | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom blue lapel pins for events, awards, or branding. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Blue lapel pins are a popular choice for corporate events, award ceremonies, and team recognition programs because blue conveys trust, loyalty, and professionalism. Whether you need satin ribbon badges for a trade show or plantable eco-friendly pins for a sustainability initiative, blue offers a versatile base that pairs well with white or gold imprinting. Choose from vertical or horizontal ribbon styles in various sizes to match your specific event needs.
heroAltText: Custom blue lapel pins with satin ribbon and gold imprint for corporate events
